name: Agile and Scrum
certifications: Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I)

beginner.summary: For team members, new Scrum Masters and Product Owners. Covers agile values, the Scrum framework, roles, events and artefacts, writing and refining user stories, estimation, sprint planning and tracking, reviews and retrospectives, Kanban basics and tools, ending with a simulated set of sprints.
prerequisites: Has worked in a team that delivers work to customers
Access to Jira or a similar board tool
outcomes: Explain agile values and the Scrum framework
Work in Scrum roles and run every Scrum event
Write, refine and estimate user stories
Track sprints with boards and charts and improve through retrospectives

days.topic: Agile Overview and the Agile Manifesto
subtopics: The four values of the Agile Manifesto
Agile frameworks: Scrum, Kanban, XP, Lean
Where agile fits and where it does not
days.lab_task: Run the ball point game or a paper aeroplane simulation for three iterations, measure output each round and explain how inspecting and adapting improved results.
days.deliverable: Iteration results and a reflection
checks: Output improves across iterations or the reason is explained
Map each improvement to a principle
Every change linked to a principle

subtopics: Scrum theory: transparency, inspection and adaptation
Events: sprint, planning, daily scrum, review, retrospective
Artefacts: product backlog, sprint backlog, increment
Commitments: product goal, sprint goal, definition of done
days.lab_task: Build a one-page map of Scrum with all roles, events, artefacts and commitments, then answer 20 scenario questions about what Scrum says.
days.deliverable: Scrum map and scenario answers
checks: Every element of the Scrum Guide included
State the time-boxes for a one-month sprint

days.topic: Scrum Roles: Product Owner, Scrum Master and Developers
subtopics: The Scrum Master's service to the team, Product Owner and organisation
days.lab_task: Work through ten workplace scenarios and decide who is accountable in each, then spot the anti-pattern in five role descriptions from real job adverts.
days.deliverable: Scenario decisions and anti-pattern notes
checks: At least eight match the answer key
One found in each job advert with a reason

subtopics: What goes in a product backlog
days.lab_task: Write a product backlog of 25 user stories with acceptance criteria for a food delivery app, split two epics into small stories and check each story against INVEST.
days.deliverable: Product backlog in Jira

subtopics: Definition of ready as an optional practice
days.lab_task: Build a story map for the app, define the first release, order the backlog by value and effort and run a 30-minute refinement session.
days.deliverable: Story map, ordered backlog and refinement notes
checks: Release slice delivers a usable product
Order explained by value and effort
Top stories clear enough to plan

days.topic: Agile Estimation: Story Points and Planning Poker
days.lab_task: Estimate 20 backlog items with planning poker and affinity estimation, compare results and discuss the largest disagreements.
days.deliverable: Estimates and discussion notes
checks: Explain why points are not hours

days.lab_task: Run sprint planning for a two-week sprint with team capacity, a sprint goal, selected stories and a task breakdown in Jira.
days.deliverable: Sprint goal and sprint backlog

days.lab_task: Run five simulated daily scrums with injected blockers, update the board, swarm on a stuck story and keep each meeting within 15 minutes.
days.deliverable: Board snapshots and blocker log
checks: Each blocker has an owner and action

days.lab_task: Write a definition of done for the app team, check three completed stories against it and plan how to raise the definition over the next three sprints.
days.deliverable: Definition of done and checks
checks: Each marked done or not done with reasons

days.lab_task: Run a sprint review with stakeholders in a role play, demonstrate the increment, collect feedback and update the product backlog from it.
days.deliverable: Review notes and updated backlog
checks: Feedback turned into new or changed items

days.lab_task: Facilitate two retrospectives with different techniques, choose one improvement action from each and add it to the next sprint backlog.
days.deliverable: Retrospective boards and improvement actions
checks: Add actions to the sprint backlog

days.topic: Tracking Progress: Burndown, Burn-Up and Velocity
days.lab_task: Track three simulated sprints, produce burndown and burn-up charts, forecast the release date as a range and explain one chart pattern.
days.deliverable: Charts and release forecast
checks: Range based on lowest and highest velocity

subtopics: Flow metrics: cycle time, throughput, WIP
days.lab_task: Set up a Kanban board for a support team with WIP limits and policies, run a simulation for ten days and measure cycle time and throughput.
days.deliverable: Kanban board and flow metrics
checks: Board shows the breach and team stops starting work

subtopics: Why technical practices matter for Scrum teams
days.lab_task: Watch and discuss a pair programming and TDD demo, then map which XP practices would fix five quality problems in a case study team.
days.deliverable: Practice mapping and recommendations
checks: Each problem has a practice with a reason
Practical first step for each practice

days.topic: Agile Tools: Jira, Azure Boards and Confluence
subtopics: Jira projects, issue types and workflows
days.lab_task: Configure a Jira Scrum project with a custom workflow, a board, a JQL filter for blocked work, a dashboard and an automation rule, and document the team's agreements in Confluence.
days.deliverable: Jira project, dashboard and Confluence page
checks: Sprint progress and blocked work shown

days.topic: Agile Teams: Collaboration, Self-Management and Psychological Safety
days.lab_task: Create working agreements for a new team, run a team health check, discuss the results and choose two actions to improve safety and collaboration.
days.deliverable: Working agreements, health check and actions

days.topic: Agile Requirements: Personas, Journeys and Minimum Viable Products
days.lab_task: Create two personas and a journey map for the app, define an MVP and two hypotheses with success measures, and test a paper prototype with users.
days.deliverable: Personas, journey map, MVP definition and test results
checks: Smallest release that tests the main hypothesis
Each has a measurable success criterion
Findings recorded from at least three users

subtopics: Agile for marketing, HR and operations
days.lab_task: Design an agile way of working for a marketing team with a board, adapted events and value measures, and run one simulated week.
days.deliverable: Way-of-working design and week results
checks: Workflow matches the team's real work
Each event has a purpose and time-box

days.topic: Certification Preparation: PSM I and CSM
days.lab_task: Take an 80-question practice test under timed conditions, review every wrong answer against the Scrum Guide and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice score, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a Scrum Guide section

days.lab_task: Deliver a product over three simulated sprints as a Scrum team with a vision, refined backlog, all events, burndown and burn-up tracking and retrospectives, then present the results and lessons.
days.deliverable: Jira project, charts, review and retrospective records and a 10-minute presentation
checks: At least one action per sprint completed
Working product shown with stakeholder feedback
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one simulation

intermediate.summary: For practising Scrum Masters, Product Owners and agile team members. Covers facilitation and coaching, advanced product ownership, product discovery, metrics and flow, technical agility, agile at team-of-teams scale, stakeholder management, agile contracts and budgeting, and PSM II and PSPO level judgement.
prerequisites: Has worked in a Scrum or Kanban team for six months or more
Uses Jira or a similar tool
outcomes: Facilitate and coach teams through difficult situations
Own products with clear goals, discovery and value measures
Use flow metrics and forecasting to improve delivery
Work across several teams and with the wider organisation

days.lab_task: Design and facilitate a 60-minute session to agree a team's quality goals using two Liberating Structures and a decision method, then get feedback from participants.
days.deliverable: Session design, outcome and feedback
checks: Decision recorded with the method used
Participants rate the session and give comments

subtopics: Coaching the team as a system
days.lab_task: Hold three coaching conversations in role plays (a team member, a Product Owner and a team), using GROW and powerful questions, and reflect on what worked.
days.deliverable: Observer notes and reflection
checks: Most questions open, as recorded by the observer

days.topic: Advanced Product Ownership: Vision, Strategy and Roadmaps
days.lab_task: Write a product vision and strategy, set three product goals and an outcome-based roadmap, and handle three conflicting stakeholder requests in a role play.
days.deliverable: Vision, strategy, roadmap and request decisions
checks: Items expressed as outcomes, not features
Each accepted or declined with a value-based reason

subtopics: Experiments: fake doors, concierge, A/B tests
days.lab_task: Build an opportunity solution tree for a product problem, map risky assumptions, design two experiments and decide based on simulated results.
days.deliverable: Opportunity tree, assumption map, experiments and decision
checks: Each has a measure and a decision rule
Pivot or persevere justified by the data

days.lab_task: Define Evidence-Based Management measures for the product, gather baseline data from a case, and choose one improvement experiment based on the measures.
days.deliverable: Measures, baseline and experiment

subtopics: Handling technical debt in the backlog
days.lab_task: Clean up a provided 400-item backlog: remove stale items, split large stories with patterns, add technical debt items and plan two releases.
days.deliverable: Cleaned backlog and release plan

subtopics: Cycle time and work item age
"When will it be done?" and "how many?" forecasts
days.lab_task: Analyse six months of team data, set a service level expectation, run Monte Carlo forecasts for a release and find the biggest flow problem.
days.deliverable: Flow analysis, forecasts and improvement action
checks: Based on the 85th percentile cycle time
Supported by aging work or the scatterplot

subtopics: Supporting engineering practices as a Scrum Master
days.lab_task: Measure a team's DORA metrics from provided data, find the biggest technical constraint and build a technical debt plan with the Product Owner.
days.deliverable: DORA metrics, constraint analysis and debt plan

days.lab_task: Run a multi-team sprint planning for three teams on one product with a dependency board, then a combined review and an overall retrospective.
days.deliverable: Plans, dependency board and retrospective actions

subtopics: Working with managers in an agile organisation
Handling pressure for fixed scope and date
days.lab_task: Handle a stakeholder asking for fixed scope and date in a role play using a forecast and options, and build an information radiator for the stakeholders.
days.deliverable: Role-play notes and information radiator

subtopics: Time zone overlap and event scheduling
days.lab_task: Redesign the Scrum events for a team split across India, Europe and the US, set asynchronous working agreements and run a remote retrospective that keeps everyone involved.
days.deliverable: Event schedule, working agreements and retrospective results
checks: No location always meets outside working hours
Every member contributes at least one item

days.topic: The Scrum Master as Organisational Change Agent
subtopics: Serving the organisation, not only the team
Working with HR, finance and management
Building a coalition of Scrum Masters
days.lab_task: Build an organisational impediment backlog for a case company, pick the top impediment, design an experiment with management to remove it and define how to measure the result.
days.deliverable: Impediment backlog, experiment design and measures
checks: Each impediment shows its effect on teams
Owner, time-box and success measure defined

days.lab_task: Turn a fixed-price outsourcing contract into an agile contract with capacity funding, checkpoints and exit clauses, and design governance reports for finance.
days.deliverable: Agile contract outline and governance reports
checks: Both sides can exit with notice
Spend and value reported each sprint

days.topic: Dealing with Dysfunctions and Difficult Situations
days.lab_task: Diagnose dysfunctions in three case teams, choose and role-play an intervention for each and define how you will know it worked.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, interventions and measures

days.topic: Kanban at Team and Service Level
days.lab_task: Redesign a support team's board with classes of service, replenishment and service delivery reviews, then cluster three months of blockers and fix the top cause.
days.deliverable: Board design, cadence and blocker analysis
checks: Blocked time reduced in the simulation

days.lab_task: Plan how a UX designer works inside the team for three sprints, run a quick usability test on a prototype and add the findings to the backlog.
days.deliverable: Working plan, usability results and backlog updates
checks: Findings from at least five tasks
Each finding becomes an item or is rejected with a reason
Design and delivery work overlap without hand-off delays

subtopics: Dashboards in Jira and Power BI
days.lab_task: Build a dashboard with flow, quality and value metrics from Jira data, review it with the team and remove one metric that drives bad behaviour.
days.deliverable: Dashboard and review notes

days.lab_task: Play delegation poker with a management team for ten decisions, build a delegation board and plan how managers will support three teams.
days.deliverable: Delegation board and support plan
checks: Identify a leadership anti-pattern in the case

days.topic: Certification Preparation: PSM II and PSPO I
days.lab_task: Take timed practice tests for PSM II and PSPO I, review wrong answers and write a study plan.
days.deliverable: Practice scores, review and study plan

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Product and Team Improvement Engagement
subtopics: Assessment of a team and product
days.lab_task: Take on a struggling product team in a simulation: assess it, reset the product goal and roadmap, run discovery, analyse flow and forecast, coach through a dysfunction, and present a 90-day improvement plan with measures.
days.deliverable: Assessment, product artefacts, flow analysis, coaching notes and a 15-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one engagement

advanced.summary: For agile coaches, senior Scrum Masters, product leaders and transformation leads. Covers enterprise agile coaching, organisation design, scaling frameworks, lean portfolio management, agile transformation strategy, culture and leadership development, business agility, metrics at scale, coaching certifications and leading change.
prerequisites: Has worked as a Scrum Master, Product Owner or agile coach for two years or more
Knows Scrum, Kanban and flow metrics well
outcomes: Design organisations and choose scaling approaches
Develop leaders and build business agility

subtopics: Coaching, mentoring, teaching, facilitating and consulting
days.lab_task: Complete a coaching competency self-assessment, write a coaching contract for a department, run a systems coaching session in a role play and plan your own development.
days.deliverable: Self-assessment, coaching contract, session notes and development plan
checks: Goals, boundaries and success measures stated

subtopics: Team Topologies: stream-aligned, platform, enabling, complicated subsystem
Measuring the effect of design changes
days.lab_task: Map a provided organisation's value streams, redesign 12 teams with Team Topologies, define interaction modes and plan a safe transition.
days.deliverable: Value stream map, team design and transition plan
checks: Each team type and purpose clear
Defined for each team pair that works together
Steps reduce risk and include measures

days.topic: Scaling Frameworks Compared: SAFe, LeSS, Nexus and Scrum@Scale
subtopics: Why scale and when not to
days.lab_task: Compare four scaling frameworks against a provided organisation's needs, recommend one with tailoring and list the anti-patterns to avoid.
days.deliverable: Comparison, recommendation and anti-pattern list
checks: Each with an early warning sign

days.lab_task: Set up a portfolio Kanban with lean business cases, prioritise ten epics with WSJF, run a participatory budgeting session and define guardrails.
days.deliverable: Portfolio Kanban, WSJF scores, budget outcome and guardrails

days.lab_task: Assess a provided company's readiness, write a transformation vision and goals, choose pilots and build an 18-month roadmap with measures.
days.deliverable: Readiness assessment, vision, roadmap and measures
checks: Strengths and gaps backed by evidence

days.topic: Change Management and Culture for Agility
days.lab_task: Assess the culture of a case organisation, design practice changes that shift it, plan a community of practice and write a change story for leadership.
days.deliverable: Culture assessment, change plan and change story
checks: Each linked to a culture shift

days.lab_task: Design a three-month leadership development programme for 20 managers, coach one leader in a role play and define measures for leadership change.
days.deliverable: Programme design, coaching notes and measures
checks: Leader commits to a new behaviour

subtopics: Origins of lean in the Toyota Production System
The seven wastes in knowledge work
days.lab_task: Do a gemba walk of a team's process through interviews and data, list the wastes found and solve the biggest one with an A3 report.
days.deliverable: Waste list and A3 report
checks: Root cause, countermeasures and follow-up defined

days.lab_task: Design agile ways of working for HR, finance and marketing in a case company, including a beyond-budgeting approach, and map how they connect to product teams.
days.deliverable: Business agility design and connection map
checks: Rolling forecasts and guardrails replace annual budgets
Performance and hiring adapted for teams

days.topic: Agile Metrics and Measurement at Scale
subtopics: Using metrics for learning, not control
days.lab_task: Build a measurement framework and dashboard for a value stream with flow, quality, outcome and people measures, and run a metrics review with leaders.
days.deliverable: Measurement framework, dashboard and review notes
checks: Covers flow, quality, outcomes and people

days.topic: Value Stream Mapping and Flow Optimisation
days.lab_task: Map the end-to-end value stream from idea to customer for a provided product, calculate flow efficiency, design a future state and plan three improvements.
days.deliverable: Current and future value stream maps and improvement plan
checks: Waiting time reduced with specific changes

days.topic: Agile at Scale in Regulated Industries
subtopics: Compliance as part of the definition of done
Case studies from banking and healthcare
days.lab_task: Design an agile process for a regulated medical software team with compliance in the definition of done, traceability and audit evidence, and pass a mock audit.
days.deliverable: Process design, traceability and audit result
checks: Trace a requirement to tests and release

days.lab_task: Assess product management maturity in a case company, design a product operating model and coach a product manager on outcome-based goals.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, operating model and coaching notes

days.topic: Facilitating Large Groups and Planning Events
days.lab_task: Design and run a large-group planning event for 60 people across five teams in a simulation, using Open Space for unresolved issues and capturing commitments.
days.deliverable: Event design, commitments and follow-up plan
checks: Each team's commitments and dependencies recorded

days.topic: Agile Transformation Measurement and Return on Investment
subtopics: Benefits: speed, quality, engagement, customer value
days.lab_task: Build a value case for a transformation with baselines, costs and benefit measures, report a year of simulated results to executives and recommend adjustments.
days.deliverable: Value case, executive report and recommendations

days.topic: Coaching Through Conflict and Organisational Politics
days.lab_task: Mediate a conflict between two department heads in a role play, map a polarity between speed and control and plan how to handle political resistance.
days.deliverable: Mediation notes, polarity map and plan
checks: Upsides, downsides and warning signs for both poles

days.topic: Agile and AI: New Ways of Working
subtopics: AI for backlog refinement and story writing
AI in retrospectives and meeting notes
Measuring the effect of AI on delivery
days.lab_task: Use AI to draft and split user stories and summarise a retrospective, check every output, and write team agreements for AI use with measures of its effect.
days.deliverable: AI outputs with checks and team AI agreements

subtopics: Scrum Alliance and Scrum.org advanced certifications
Professional Scrum Master III and Certified Enterprise Coach
days.lab_task: Build a coaching portfolio with three case studies, map it to the requirements of an advanced certification and write a two-year growth plan.
days.deliverable: Coaching portfolio and growth plan
checks: Each shows context, approach and results

days.lab_task: Diagnose three stalled transformation cases, choose a reset strategy for each and write a reset message for leaders and teams.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, reset strategies and reset messages

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Agile Transformation Plan
days.lab_task: Produce a transformation plan for a 1,000-person organisation with an assessment, team design, scaling approach, lean portfolio, leadership and culture plan, measurement framework and coaching plan, then present it to a mock executive team.
days.deliverable: Transformation plan, dashboards and a 20-minute executive presentation
checks: Value streams and team types defined
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one plan
